name: Biology PhD
institution: University of North Carolina at Charlotte
summary: Interdisciplinary research PhD in biology, distinct from the Bioinformatics and Computational Biology program.
detailsNote: Official information available; Fall 2027 dates not confirmed. January 15 is undated. Students may be matched with tentative mentors or rotations; no single admission model asserted. Funding is conditional on eligibility, progress and resources.

publishedDeadlines.label: Fall application/funding consideration
publishedDeadlines.note: Undated annual deadline. Spring exceptional admission October 1; separate assistantship page says July 1 for spring funding, so confirm early.

documents: Three references, at least two faculty

applicationFee.note: International $85; US citizen/PR $75. Department cannot waive fees. Central limited routes: qualifying permanent UNC Charlotte employees, US Ronald McNair participants, US military service members. No citizenship restriction on employee category; international applicants must confirm category eligibility; allow 1â€“2 weeks.

english.toefl: 83 before January 21, 2026; 4.5 on or after; department prefers legacy 100
english.note: Official agency reports; legacy scores valid two years. Exemption: one academic year of postsecondary study in US/listed country within five years of enrollment, or one calendar year professional work in US/listed country with heavy written/spoken English. TA eligibility assessed by ELTI before first semester.

requirements.note: BA/BS; overall/science GPA at least3, competitive biology3.4. Relevant major or24credits in listed bioscience/interdisciplinary fields. Genetics, physiology and cell/molecular courses required; strong candidates have year each general/organic chemistry, physics and college math. SOP covers motivation, degree fit, preparation/deficiencies and faculty/research interests. Faculty contact encouraged. GRE not required, optional scores accepted.

funding.note: Eligible students: TA support guaranteed eight semesters, later as available; satisfactory progress and teaching evaluations required. Program expects TA first two years then adviser-funded RA. Published undated TA $22,000/academic year, competitive and GPA3 required. Eligible assistantship holders get tuition waiver and health insurance (GASP), up to ten semesters. Confirm eligibility and international terms.
